content: Hello! Welcome to customer support. How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I’m having trouble accessing my account. I forgot my password.
No problem, I can help you reset it. Please click the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
I clicked it, and now it wants my email address.
Great. Please enter the email address you registered with and submit the form.
Okay, I entered my email. It says a verification code was sent.
Perfect. Check your inbox for a message from us. Once you find the code, enter it on the verification screen.
Found the code and entered it. Now it’s asking me to set a new password.
Go ahead and choose a new secure password, then confirm it. Once you submit, your account should be accessible.
All done. I’m back in my account, thank you!
